FISHING LICENCE · POLAND

Poland fishing licence

Foreign visitors who stay temporarily in Poland are exempt from the inland angler's card. They still need the permit for the chosen water; the exemption does not provide free access.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Temporary foreign visitors need the water user's inland permit.
  • Sea anglers must meet the separate marine fee requirements.

Who doesn’t

  • Foreign nationals who stay temporarily in Poland do not need the karta wędkarska, but still need the water permit.

Extra stamps and permits

  • Water-user permit
    For the specific inland fishing district or water.

Saltwater

Marine recreational fishing uses a separate fee system. An inland water permit does not replace it; individuals must carry payment proof and identification.

Rules visitors should know

  • Use the inland permit only in its listed waters.
  • Follow the water manager's fishing rules.
  • Carry the marine fee receipt and identification when that fee applies.

How to buy

Buy participating Polish Waters permits through WIR or the WIR app. Other managers issue their own permits.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Poland?

Foreign visitors who stay temporarily in Poland are exempt from the inland angler's card. They still need the permit for the chosen water; the exemption does not provide free access.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Poland?

Buy participating Polish Waters permits through WIR or the WIR app. Other managers issue their own permits.
